chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: From cornet to saxophone; playing classics in church
summary: The saxophone came after he got good on cornet; he played church music and only classics, no jazz.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: So when did you get to saxophone? Was that pretty close to the same period? Because I remember you as a saxophone player.
Oh, yeah, you know, when I bought the saxophone, they give me the saxophone later on, when I got pretty good on the coronet -- yeah, now we're getting
I had to bring up the cornet. I forgot --
That's a start, see, because I knew that was the beginning.
Yeah, that's the beginning. And then when I got the cornet, then I jumped onto -- boy, I got so I could play it real good, and played in churches and things like that.
Was there gospels at the time, or jazz or what-have-you? In the churches, what did you play, what kind of music?
So what about -- at that period, did you do any jazz playing, like, say, when I was a young man in high school, we had a couple of jazz bands and things like that. Did you play anything like that?
No, we played nothing but the classics.
